open_blockers.detail: Xcode 26.3 installed but never signed in: `security find-identity -v -p codesigning` reports 0 valid identities, no provisioning profiles, no Xcode accounts. Godot fails the iOS export with 'App Store Team ID not specified'. A FREE Apple ID is enough — Xcode > Settings > Accounts > + creates a Personal Team that can install on your own devices (7-day expiry). Paid Developer Program only needed for TestFlight/App Store in Phase 8. Owner must sign in; engineer then reads the Team ID into export_presets.cfg.
Android SDK and Java not installed. Godot reports missing platform-tools and build-tools. Owner will install manually and report back; command in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md.

open_blockers.blocks: any future brew install, including the Android toolchain
open_blockers.detail: /usr/local/bin is root-owned so Homebrew cannot symlink. Fix: sudo chown -R $(whoami) /usr/local/bin

open_decisions.detail: Nine proposed hex values in docs/ART_BIBLE.md, deliberately unlocked. Needs owner sign-off plus a colourblind check and a phone-size test render.
'Wastemarch' is a working title. Needs USPTO/EUIPO and app-store searches before any public listing.

phase_0_note: Phase 1 started partially with the owner's go-ahead. Only sim-core, which the Phase 0 gate cannot affect. The godot-rust GDExtension is deliberately NOT started — it needs the export templates and a device, which is what the gate guards.
